name: Be Honest
overview: Scripture calls believers to integrity and truthfulness, emphasizing that dishonesty is incompatible with the new life in Christ. Ephesians 4:25 and Colossians 3:9 instruct Christians to put away lying and to speak truthfully to one another, reflecting our unity as members of the body of Christ. Matthew 7:15 warns against false prophets who disguise themselves with deceit, highlighting the danger of inward corruption despite outward appearances. Together, these verses underscore that honesty is essential to living faithfully and guarding the community from spiritual harm.
